verdict.rationale: Archived docs described Uplink, which exposed 'an MCP server running on any machine as a regular Smithery connection' so a private tool could run 'without hosting it'. Smithery's own shutdown notice says its connection-management services stopped on October 31, 2026, including the API, Connect, accounts, CLI and SDKs, and that it remains only as a non-proxied registry. Managed connections no longer exist, so the bridging capability is no longer delivered.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bridge a locally running MCP server into the platform as a managed remote connection without deploying it
